youtube.baslik: Why does a child seem to hear better on some days? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In otitis media with effusion (OME), hearing loss is not stable; it changes over weeks with the amount and thickness of the fluid. In the example course, the average threshold sometimes nears normal and sometimes reaches 35 decibels; for the child, this means hearing the same word clearly one day and incompletely another, an inconsistent auditory input. When fluid lasts for months, this inconsistency overlaps with the period of rapid language growth; diagnosis and treatment decisions belong to the ENT physician.
